title: Next.js App Router
description: Server Components minimize JS sent to the client. Pages load fast because the browser receives HTML, not a bundle that needs to render. Result: Lighthouse 95+ with zero compromises on interactivity.

title: Tailwind CSS v4
description: Zero dead CSS — only the classes used ship to production. Dark mode via class strategy means no runtime theme flickering. Co-located styles make components self-documenting and easy to refactor.

title: shadcn/ui over component libraries
description: Component source lives in the project, not behind a version in node_modules. Full control over markup, styling, and accessibility. No forced updates, no breaking changes from upstream — just clean, owned code.

title: Progressive Web App
description: The site is installable and works offline with a three-tier caching strategy: Cache First for assets, Stale While Revalidate for pages, Network First for dynamic content. First revisit loads in under 500ms.

title: Plain Three.js, not React Three Fiber
description: R3F adds ~200KB to the bundle for a single visual effect. Plain Three.js with dynamic import keeps the shader background at ~30KB gzipped while retaining full WebGL control and clean lifecycle management.

title: CSS scroll-driven over JS observers
description: Scroll animations run on the compositor thread — no JavaScript, no jank, no layout thrashing. IntersectionObserver fallback ensures Firefox and Safari users still see smooth fade-ins via @supports queries.
